name: ~Uta~
source:
A piece about a lonely (and apparently unpopular) young musician and the quiet girl who listens to him sing every day.

[From [url=http://altogether.insani.org/2005/resources/index/phase02-plainsong.html]Misu-Net & Seung Park[/url]]
translation:
关于一个孤独的（显然不太受欢迎的）年轻音乐人和那个每天静静听他唱歌的女孩的故事。

[引自[url=http://altogether.insani.org/2005/resources/index/phase02-plainsong.html]Misu-Net & Seung Park[/url]]
